sources.title: Hugging Face Transformers - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Hugging Face Transformers is an open-source deep learning library developed by Hugging Face. It provides implementations of pretrained transformer and other neural network models for training and inference, including models for text, images, audio, video, and multimodal learning. [1][2]
